entities.label: Representation
entities.definition: A digital or physical media object that embodies a specific version, format, or instance of a Material, making it accessible or consumable by users.

identifier.description: The identifier of the item, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links.

accessResource.description: URL, path, or inline content providing access to the resource.

preferred.description: TRUE if this is the preferred representation among multiple formats.

isOcxGenerated.description: TRUE if generated during OCX packaging, FALSE if from source system.

lmsLoadingGuidance.description: Vendor guidance on whether this representation should be loaded into an LMS.

inLanguage.description: Language of this representation, if different from the parent Material.

dateModified.description: When this representation was last modified.

hasRepresentation.description: Links to one or more Representation objects that provide access to the Material in different formats.

hasPart.description: A hasPart relationship connects a parent curriculum element to its constituent components, allowing hierarchical organization of instructional content. This includes Courses containing LessonGroupings or Materials, LessonGroupings containing Lessons, nested LessonGroupings, or Materials, Lessons containing Activities or Materials, and Activities containing Materials.
